craft_notes: Sthāyin: surge-and-return — threefold seal. Rows: motion then count. Read aloud: swell, return, count.

lines: The inner-brimmed lesser wheel, surging, attains the wheel; it too surges as of old.
So this outflow's hidden sense is three.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āntarapūrṇasamucchaladanucakraṃ yāti cakram atha tad api ucchalati prāgvad iti trividho 'nvartho visargo 'yam
